title: Why Winning A Nobel Now Takes So Much Longer
hook: The Nobel once crowned young stars. Now it waits for them to age.
closing: Genius isn't getting older. The wait is, so young scientists now wait much longer for their moment.
question: Have you peaked yet? Tell me below.

segments.say: Physics breakthroughs now come about thirteen years later in a scientist's life than a century ago. Big ideas take longer to arrive.
Nobel physics discoveries by people under forty fell from most to about one in five. Fewer young researchers are landing the big wins.
Last century, most chemistry Nobel winners were under forty. This century, not one. The prize now goes to the seasoned.
